#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

const int MAXN = 1000005;
bool visited[MAXN];

ll fastExponentiation(ll base, int exponent) {
    ll result = 1;
    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1) result = (result * base) % 1000000007;
        exponent >>= 1;
        base = (base * base) % 1000000007;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fastExponentiation(p, p - 1) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << fastExponentiation(p, p) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
        if (visited[i]) continue;
        ll j = i;
        while (!visited[j]) {
            visited[j] = true;
            j = (j * k) % p;
        }
        count++;
    }
    cout << fastExponentiation(p, count) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
